reviews.title: Pleased traveler
reviews.review_text: I have suitcases, but I had nothing to transport my suit and sport coat in without wrinkling them. I needed both for a trip. The bag was large enough I placed a full suit, a sport coat, slacks, and a couple dress shirts in it. The suit and sport coat were on wooden hangers, which take up more room, but I still had enough room for the rest. I was traveling by car, so I laid the garment bag on top of what else we had in the back of the car. When I carried the bag in and out of the house and where we stayed, I folded the bag in half, without wrinkling anything inside the bag. It was easy to handle, just extending my hangers through the opening at the top of the bag. I left the clothes in the bag, in the closet, until I needled them.
